note: Boss guides for the Raid Boss Strats tab. Heroic focus. Officer notes, pictures and edited cliff notes live on the sheet's Strat Notes tab. Cliff note lines can start with [T], [H], [D] or a mix like [TH] to show which roles they affect. Guide lines starting with "HC: " are Heroic additions.

bosses.name: Imperator Averzian
bosses.summary: The room is a 3×3 board. Averzian and his adds claim tiles; if he ever owns three in a row, the raid wipes. Everything in this fight is about deciding which tiles he gets.
cliff: [THD] THREE IN A ROW = WIPE. Watch the board before every soak.
[THD] Soak on the add: drop Umbral Collapse on a Voidshaper, then SPRINT to the second one.
[T] Keep the boss off claimed tiles and away from his adds, or he's immune and hits 75% harder.
[T] Tanks swap at 8–10 Blackening Wounds. Adds run at whoever has the most.
[D] Kill order: Voidshaper, then Stalwart, then Voidmaws.

items: Shadow's Advance lets Averzian claim territory. A claimed tile can't be taken back.
If he holds three tiles in a line he starts March of the Endless: that's the wipe.
Each wave of adds tries to claim a tile. The raid's job is to make sure only one tile gets claimed per wave, and that it's one we can afford.
A player gets a big soak circle. They run to the called marker, on top of an Abyssal Voidshaper, and everyone stacks to split the damage.
The soak strips the add's 99% damage reduction so it can die before it finishes claiming.
As soon as the first soak explodes, the whole raid sprints to the second tile and soaks again. Movement speed and gateways help.

tank: Blackening Wounds: every melee hit lowers your max health by 4% for 20 seconds and stacks. Swap at 8–10 stacks.
When adds spawn they run at the tank with the most stacks. Swap at the start of each add wave, and the high-stack tank stands away from the boss.
Imperator's Glory: within 10 yards of claimed territory the boss deals 75% more damage and takes 99% less.
HC: On Heroic his adds give him the same buff when he is within 10 yards of them. Keep him clear of both.
Move him quickly to the area you want to fight in for each wave.
HC: In the intermission, tank every add at least 10 yards from the boss.
healer: Dark Upheaval: a burst of raid damage followed by ticking damage. This is the main place for raid cooldowns.
The sprint between the two soaks is when people drop: top the raid before the second soak.
raid: Kill priority: Abyssal Voidshaper, then Shadowguard Stalwart, then Voidmaws.
Stack for every Umbral Collapse so the damage is split, then move together.
HC: Voidmaws at 35% health run to the nearest claimed tile to heal: kill them before they get there.
wipes: Averzian claims three tiles in a row.
A soak lands off the add, so it keeps its 99% damage reduction and claims the tile.
Boss tanked on claimed ground or next to adds.
Tank holds too many Blackening Wounds stacks.

normal: The board, Umbral Collapse soaks and add waves all work the same.
Adds don't buff the boss, and Voidmaws don't run off to heal.
heroic: Imperator's Glory also triggers when the boss is within 10 yards of his adds.
Intermission adds must be tanked 10+ yards from the boss.
Voidmaws at 35% run to a claimed tile to heal.
mythic: Cosmic Shell shields the Voidshapers: two Void Marked dispels are needed to break it.
Six players get Void Marked and are dispelled on the adds.
Voidshapers at 100 energy turn into Endwalkers that must be hard-swapped.
Oblivion's Wrath spikes return.

ach.name: The Only Winning Move Is Not To Play
ach.req: Defeat Imperator Averzian after he destroys your banners.
how: Place them in a row on the board.
Let Umbral Collapse destroy them.
Still never let him get three Voidshapers in a row.
pre: Three players pick up the banners on the way in, before the boss arena.

pace.t: Don't push him low until all three banners are destroyed: you need Umbral Collapses to land on them, so expect a few extra soak cycles. Once the banners are gone, kill him normally. The usual rule still applies: never three Voidshapers in a row.

map.n: A 3×3 board. Three claimed tiles in a line = March of the Endless (wipe). Decide each wave which ONE tile he gets.
The soak target runs onto the Abyssal Voidshaper on the called tile and everyone stacks: the soak strips its 99% damage reduction.
As soon as the first soak goes off, the whole raid sprints to the second tile and soaks again. Gateways and speed help.

bosses.name: Vorasius
bosses.style: Single target with add waves · ramping damage
bosses.summary: A repeating loop: Primordial Roar, Shadowclaw Slams, Blistercreep adds to break walls, Void Breath. Every Roar adds a raid-wide damage stack, so the longer it goes the harder it gets.
cliff: [T] TANK SOAKS EVERY SLAM. A missed Shadowclaw Slam wipes the raid.
[T] Tank A takes slams 1 and 2, then hides. Tank B takes the rest. Flip next cycle.
[THD] After a slam lands, step INTO the impact spot to dodge the rings.
[D] Two Blistercreep explosions per wall on Heroic. Kill them where they're needed.
[THD] Stack in front of him for Roar. Personals when the first 3 adds die.

items: Primordial Roar: the boss pulls everyone in and does raid damage, then a bigger hit and a knockback at the end. Stack in front of the boss every time so healers can cover it.
Each Roar gives the raid a stack of Primordial Power, a damage-over-time that keeps stacking: this is the soft enrage.
Shadowclaw Slam every 10–15 seconds, then Blistercreep adds, then Void Breath, then repeat.
HC: Void Crystal walls go up. Blistercreeps explode when they die: on Heroic it takes two explosions to destroy a wall (one on Normal).
Kill them on the markers, starting with the ones furthest back, because their goo expands.
Killing the first set of 3 adds does raid-wide damage: everyone uses a personal.

tank: Shadowclaw Slam must be soaked by a tank or the raid wipes.
The first two slams each cycle apply Smashed: 150% more physical damage taken for 2 minutes, and it stacks.
Tank A soaks slams 1 and 2 (big defensive on the second), then plays safe for 2 minutes. Tank B soaks every slam after that. Next cycle swap roles.
Each slam sends out expanding Aftershock rings from the impact point.
healer: Roar is the big repeat hit: plan a cooldown for each one, more as Primordial Power stacks.
First add set dying = raid damage. Have a cooldown or ask for personals.
Tank A is extremely vulnerable for 2 minutes after the double Smashed.
raid: Melee and most of the raid play near the tank. When the slam lands, step into the impact spot: that's safe from the rings.
Otherwise run into a gap in the Aftershock ring.
Kill Blistercreeps where they break the walls; never let them die in the raid.
wipes: Unsoaked Shadowclaw Slam.
Wrong tank soaks a slam while Smashed.
Fight drags on and Primordial Power stacks too high.
Walls not broken in time.

normal: One Blistercreep explosion breaks a wall.
Play around the middle for Shadowclaw Slam.
heroic: Two Blistercreep explosions per wall.
mythic: Three explosions per wall, with 7 adds: at most one can be wasted.
Adds must die on the wall, and their pools are permanent and grow.
Raid-wide personals after the first three adds die; groups split left and right walls.

ach.name: Hungry Hungry Hatchlings
ach.req: Defeat Vorasius after every player feeds their hatchling until it falls asleep.
how: After the pull, a Surprisingly Large Egg appears on the right side of the room.
Every player clicks the Hungry Hatchling peeking out of it (set it as your focus target).
In the wall phase, kill Blistercreeps: they drop meat the hatchlings eat.
When a hatchling has enough it falls asleep and shows a heart. Once all are asleep, kill the boss.
ach.note: If you die you lose your hatchling and the group has to reset.

pace.t: Most of the damage goes into Blistercreeps so the hatchlings get fed through the wall phases. Hold the boss around 30% until every hatchling is asleep, then burn. Every extra Roar adds raid damage, so plan healer cooldowns for a long pull.

map.n: Everyone stacks in front of the boss with the tank so healers can cover the pull-in, the hit and the knockback.
Step INTO the impact spot after it lands: it is safe from the Aftershock rings. Otherwise run through a gap in a ring.
Kill each add ON its marker at the wall, back ones first (the goo spreads). HC: two explosions per wall.

bosses.name: Fallen-King Salhadaar
bosses.summary: One phase on a repeating script. Riftlabs send void orbs at the king; if one reaches him the raid takes a damage-over-time that won't stop. Energy builds to Entropic Unraveling, then it repeats.
cliff: [D] NO ORB TOUCHES THE KING. Kill Concentrated Void on sight.
[D] Not both orbs at once: wait for Dark Radiation to drop before killing the second.
[TD] Star on the tank? Point the spikes away from the raid.
[T] Swap tanks around 8 Destabilizing Strikes.
[H] Unraveling at 100 energy: healer cooldown, everyone alive.

items: Two Concentrated Void orbs spawn from the Riftlabs and drift toward the boss.
If one reaches him he gets Void Infusion: big Shadow damage to everyone plus damage every second for a minute. In practice it's a wipe.
HC: On Heroic each orb releases Dark Radiation when it dies: an 8-second raid DoT that stacks. Kill one, let it fall off, then kill the second.
The machinery fills his energy. At 100 he casts Entropic Unraveling: heavy raid damage.
Afterwards he casts Void Convergence again and the loop repeats.

tank: Destabilizing Strikes: his melee applies a stacking Shadow DoT. Swap at about 8 stacks.
He throws a dark star at the current tank (Shattering Twilight): a huge Shadow hit, then Twilight Spikes run outward from the impact.
HC: On Heroic the star also hits several more players.
Face the impact so the spike lines go away from the raid.
healer: Entropic Unraveling at 100 energy is the big cooldown moment.
Despotic Command puts circles on several players: they run to the edge of the room first. Dispelling leaves a pool and a healing absorb.
HC: Orb deaths (Dark Radiation) add stacking raid damage; never let both orbs die together.
raid: Ranged and cleave on orbs the moment they spawn.
Drop puddles at the edges. The fight only gets hard if the room fills up.
HC: Marked for the star on Heroic: aim your spikes away from everyone.
wipes: An orb reaches the boss (Void Infusion).
Both orbs killed together.
Puddles dropped in the middle until there's no room.
Spike lines aimed through the raid.

normal: Orbs can die back to back: no Dark Radiation.
Shattering Twilight only hits the tank.
heroic: Killing an orb gives the raid Dark Radiation (8-second stacking DoT).
Shattering Twilight also targets several players.
mythic: Killed orbs stay in the room and hurt anyone under them, then come back with less health when new orbs spawn.
Tanks kite so all orbs die in one spot.
Fractured Projection adds: interrupt them one at a time in the same window.
Enrage after the third Entropic Unraveling.

ach.name: It's Treason Then
ach.req: Defeat Salhadaar after everyone kneels to him before the fight.
how: During the fight a shade of each player spawns now and then.
Face your own shade or it kills you; otherwise play the fight normally.
pre: Before the pull timer, everyone kneels to Salhadaar, one at a time (it gives you a debuff).

pace.t: Kneel before the pull, then it's a normal kill: everyone just turns to face their own shade when it appears.

map.n: Two orbs leave the Riftlabs and drift to the king. Kill them on the way: one reaching him is a wipe. HC: kill one, let Dark Radiation fall off, then the other.
The fight only gets hard when the room fills up: drop every puddle at the edges.

bosses.name: Vaelgor & Ezzorak
bosses.summary: Two dragons with separate health. They must stay more than 15 yards apart and within 10% health of each other, or both get a 100% damage buff. The combo always runs Void Howl, Nullbeam, Gloom; at 100 energy they fly for an intermission.
cliff: [TD] 15 YARDS APART, 10% HEALTH APART. Twilight Bond doubles their damage.
[THD] Break your tether the moment Nullzone hits. Tank breaks LAST.
[HD] Gloom soak: 5 or more, a fresh group each time. Diminish = you don't soak.
[D] Never stand behind a dragon (Tail Lash).
[THD] Intermission: everyone in the bubble. Kill Manifestation of Midnight fast.

items: Always the same order: Void Howl, then Nullbeam / Nullzone, then Gloom about 10 seconds later.
Expect two Gloom casts before the first intermission.
Both dragons fly up and cast Midnight Flames. Stack inside the Radiant Barrier in the middle; anyone outside takes heavy damage.
Players with purple circles step to the side.
Kill Manifestation of Midnight fast: every 30 seconds alive it gains 75% attack speed.
They land, go back to their spots, and the fight starts over. The flying dragon alternates after each intermission.

tank: Vaelwing (Vaelgor): physical hits that ramp each strike and reset when the target changes.
Rakfang (Ezzorak): a massive physical hit that also puts a growing healing absorb on you.
Nullbeam: a 4-second frontal beam with a stacking DoT. The current tank soaks about 8 stacks to weaken Nullzone's pull, then steps out.
Grappling Maw (whichever is flying): grips the tank; the farther away you are the more it hurts.
Swap after every Gloom by running to the other dragon. Don't drag them. Tank near spawn, close to the 15-yard limit.
healer: HC: Nullzone Implosion: heavy raid DoT for 6 seconds when the last tether snaps (bigger on Heroic). Your main cooldown each combo.
Midnight Flames in the intermission: only people inside the barrier survive comfortably.
Dread Breath fears its target: dispel after the cone has hit and the player has stepped aside.
Tail Lash and Impale cause bleeds and a 3-second stun.
raid: Stand between the dragons and hit from the sides. Never behind (Tail Lash).
Void Howl: stack tightly without overlapping circles so the Voidorbs spawn together. After tethers break, grip them in and AoE them. Stun or interrupt their Voidbolt.
Gloom: the first goes to the blue marker, soaked by 5+ ranged to shrink the puddle. Rotate markers and groups.
HC: Soakers get Diminish for 1 minute and can't soak again: have teams ready.
Dread Breath target steps to the side so the cone misses the raid.
wipes: Twilight Bond: dragons too close or health too far apart.
Tethers not broken, or the tank breaks too early (Nullzone Implosion).
People outside the barrier for Midnight Flames.
Someone with Diminish soaks Gloom.
Manifestation of Midnight left alive.

normal: Gloom has no soak debuff.
Smaller burst when Nullzone ends.
heroic: Gloom soakers get Diminish: 1 minute before they can soak again.
Bigger raid burst when the last player leaves Nullzone.
mythic: Our sources haven't listed the Mythic changes yet: see the full guides.

ach.name: Ready, Set, Snap!
ach.req: Defeat Vaelgor & Ezzorak after every player breaks each Nullzone tether within 3 seconds.
how: Stay close together.
Use group speed (Stampeding Roar, Wind Rush Totem) so everyone breaks the tether at the same moment.
Healing cooldowns for each Nullsnap, since each one hits the raid.
ach.note: A big step up even on Normal. More item level makes it easier (faster kill, fewer Nullzones).
pre: Bring raid speed: Stampeding Roar (Druid), Wind Rush Totem (Shaman) or similar, so everyone can break tethers together.

pace.l: Burn as fast as you can
pace.t: Every Nullzone is another chance for one player to fail the 3-second snap, so the fewer Nullzones the better. Full damage from the pull, stay stacked and move together with raid speed.

map.n: Dragons 15+ yards apart. Raid stands between them and hits from the sides. Never behind (Tail Lash).
The first Gloom goes to the blue marker: 5+ ranged soak it to shrink the puddle. Rotate markers and teams (HC: Diminish).
Both fly up for Midnight Flames: everyone inside the Radiant Barrier in the middle. Purple circles step to the edge of it. Kill the Manifestation fast.

bosses.name: Lightblinded Vanguard
bosses.lust: On pull (save some cooldowns for after the bubbles)
bosses.summary: Three paladins at once: General Amias Bellamy (Protection), Commander Venel Lightblood (Retribution) and War Chaplain Senn (Holy). Each one at 100 energy turns on an aura and fires their big ability, in a set order starting with Bellamy. Kill them together: a survivor avenges the fallen.
cliff: [D] KILL THEM TOGETHER. A dead paladin makes the others +10% every 2 seconds.
[T] Drag the boss at 100 energy to the edge BEFORE the aura ends.
[H] Divine Toll waves silence you: healers, don't get clipped.
[T] Tanks swap after every Judgment.
[D] Lust on pull, but Bellamy and Senn bubble for 8 seconds: don't dump everything instantly.

items: Light Infused ticks damage on the whole raid all fight.
Each paladin gains energy; at 100 they activate an aura that empowers the others and unleash their biggest attack. Order: Bellamy first, Senn third.
HC: When an aura expires, that boss leaves a permanent Consecration on the ground, so they should be at the edge.
When one dies, the others avenge them (+10% damage every 2 seconds). Spread damage so they die close together.
General Amias Bellamy (Protection): Aura of Devotion (bosses within 40 yards take 75% less damage), then Divine Toll, waves of shields across the room that silence anyone hit. Also Avenger's Shield.

Commander Venel Lightblood (Retribution): Aura of Wrath (bosses within 40 yards deal 100% more damage for 15 seconds), then Execution Sentence on four players. Also Judgment into a hard follow-up hit.
War Chaplain Senn (Holy): Aura of Peace (buffs the other bosses and pacifies players who attack them), then Blinding Light with a Sacred Shield on herself. Also Tyr's Wrath, a healing absorb.

tank: Swap right after each Judgment, or the follow-up kills your co-tank.
HC: When a boss is about to reach 100 energy, drag it to the edge so its permanent Consecration doesn't cover the room.
Lots of quick taunts all fight: call your swaps.
healer: Heavy healing fight: Light Infused never stops and Senn adds absorbs and a raid channel. Five to six healers is normal on Heroic.
Don't get hit by Divine Toll waves: a silenced healer is a dead raid.
Watch for overlaps of the 100-energy abilities and plan cooldowns there.
raid: Multi-DoT and cleave: keep the three bosses' health even.
Dodge Divine Toll and stay out of Consecration.
Stand near Senn for Tyr's Wrath so the absorb is spread.
wipes: One paladin dies far ahead of the others.
A 100-energy boss left in the middle, so Consecration takes the room.
Healers silenced by Divine Toll.
Missed tank swap after Judgment.
bosses.hero: Pop Hero on pull, but hold some cooldowns: Bellamy and Senn bubble for 8 seconds

normal: No Consecration after the 100-energy cycles: the room stays clean.
heroic: Every 100-energy cycle leaves a permanent Consecration: drag bosses to the edge.
mythic: Zealous Spirit empowers one paladin (30% more damage, enhanced ability) and passes between them, lining up their big abilities.
Two bosses start with Divine Shield: Mass Dispel after lust.
Everything hits much harder: a bigger healing check.

ach.name: Aura Farming
ach.req: Defeat the Vanguard while the whole raid has Maximum Aura.
how: Pull normally and stand in each boss's aura when they hit 100 energy.
Keep going until everyone has Maximum Aura.
Capped players step aside: Maximum Aura stuns nearby players with less.
pre: Everyone clicks the Tome of Divinity on the small hill to the right of the stairs, before the arena (gives Aura Farming).

pace.t: Let every boss reach 100 energy and stand in each aura until the whole raid has Maximum Aura. Ease off if any boss drops toward 30% before everyone is capped. Capped players step away from the group. Expect a long, healer-heavy pull.

bosses.name: Crown of the Cosmos
bosses.style: Cleave until Phase 3 · heavy healing check
bosses.summary: Alleria's fight. Phase 1 kills three Undying Sentinels in order, then two intermissions with arrows and a pull, a phase on the edge of a split platform, and a final burn on Alleria while the platform is eaten away.
cliff: [D] ARROWS MAKE THINGS KILLABLE. Hit each Sentinel once, don't re-hit.
[THD] Intermissions: get hit early, never twice. Arrow debuff = don't move.
[D] Interrupt Void Barrage. Voidspawn at 100 energy one-shots.
[THD] P3 tethers break Ranged → Melee → Tank, one at a time.
[THD] Grab a Dark Rush feather BEFORE Devouring Cosmos eats your slice.

items: Kill order: Demair, then Vorelus, then Morium.
Sentinels can't die until a Silverstrike Arrow hits them (Umbral Tether). Hit all three early so Corrupting Essence builds, but don't re-hit one without reason: that resets the stacks.
They teleport back if pulled more than 25 yards from their portal: bring the adds to them.
A Sentinel at 100 energy starts one-shotting people. Kill on time.
Dodge Grasp of Emptiness beams and stray arrows.
HC: Grasp of Emptiness hits two players instead of one, and several players hit by Void Expulsion drop a second pool a few seconds later.
Alleria knocks everyone up and the room splits into three slices. Stay in your slice near the middle and fight the pull.
Stellar Emission stacks fast, ramping damage and pull strength. An arrow resets it.
HC: Silverstrike Barrage makes you take 300% more arrow damage for 8 seconds: get hit early, avoid a double hit, get hit again as it drops.
Dodge Singularity Eruption puddles.
Hug the fissure at the edge of your slice; always rotate the same way.
Ranger Captain's Mark replaces the arrow and bounces between marked players. It also clears Void effects and makes Voidspawns killable.
Call of the Void spawns two Undying Voidspawns: mark them, grip them in, interrupt Void Barrage, kill fast. At 100 energy they can't be interrupted and hit massively.
When space runs out, bait the last puddles, cross Volatile Fissure quickly (each crossing stacks a DoT) and rotate counter-clockwise.
Same arrow and pull rules as Intermission 1.
HC: Orbiting Matter: a wall of orbs chases you, so the raid rotates at least one slice and must all end on the same one. Don't move while the arrow debuff is on the raid.
Alleria lands and is tanked in the middle. Lust, potions, every cooldown.

Aspect of the End tethers one tank, one melee and one ranged. Breaking a tether (30 yards) causes Gravity Collapse: raid damage plus 300% physical damage taken for 12 seconds. Break order: Ranged, then Melee, then Tank, when the raid is healthy.
HC: Grasp of Emptiness obelisks return, two circles at a time: move as a group out of their beams.
Devouring Cosmos covers your slice, deals heavy damage and blocks healing. Grab a Dark Rush feather beforehand and glide to the next slice. This is the hard enrage.

tank: Phase 1: one tank holds Morium by its portal and collects Void Droplets; it hits hard (physical plus Shadow, with knockbacks). Keep a healer in range, ideally a melee healer.
Rift Slash: heavy physical hit, -10% stats for 20 seconds, stacking. Swap at 2–3 stacks.
Phase 3: pre-swap after Aspect of the End goes out. The tank who breaks their tether takes 300% physical damage, so the other tank holds Alleria.
healer: Null Corona (all phases): a big absorb. Heal through it; dispel only if the target is about to die, because the remainder jumps to someone else. Avoid dispelling people with HoTs.
Echoing Darkness: raid damage every 2 seconds, growing when nobody is in melee; an arrow resets it.
Cooldowns for: Void Expulsion explosions, both intermission pulls, Gravity Collapse in Phase 3, and before Devouring Cosmos (no healing inside it).
Aspect of the End cuts healing received, and it gets worse over time. Don't let people linger near the Simulacrum (Empowering Darkness).
raid: Phase 1: melee on their assigned add, ranged just outside the stack to bait Void Expulsion. Arrows in the planned order.
Movement cooldowns for the intermission pulls.
Phase 2: interrupt Void Barrage, kill Voidspawns right after they're marked.
Phase 3: stack on Alleria, break tethers in order, move together away from beams.
wipes: Devouring Cosmos: the raid can't reach feathers in time.
Void Barrage not interrupted, or a Sentinel or Voidspawn reaches 100 energy.
Double arrow hits in the intermissions.
Several tethers broken at once (Gravity Collapse).
Beams cutting through the stack in Phase 3.
bosses.hero: Pop Hero at the start of Phase 3, when Alleria lands

normal: One Grasp of Emptiness at a time.
No follow-up Void Expulsion pools.
No Silverstrike Barrage debuff in the intermissions.
heroic: Void Expulsion leaves follow-up pools; Grasp of Emptiness on two players.
Silverstrike Barrage: 300% more arrow damage for 8 seconds.
Intermission 2 orb wall forces a slice rotation.
Phase 3: two Grasp circles at a time.
mythic: Our sources haven't listed the Mythic changes yet: see the full guides.

ach.name: We Will, In Fact, See It Again
ach.req: Defeat Crown of the Cosmos after killing a Fleshy Monstrosity and returning its meat to The Emptiness.
how: Stand in the void puddle behind Umbric's portal until you have 10 Clinging Void stacks: you get a Lump of Flesh (10 minutes).
After Morium, Demair and Vorelus die, Alleria starts the intermission: get close enough to use the extra action button, but don't get pulled into the middle.
Once the whole raid has thrown their lumps, a Fleshy Monstrosity spawns: kill it, then finish the fight.

pace.t: Build your 10 Clinging Void stacks early and kill Phase 1 at normal pace. In the intermission everyone throws their lump, the raid kills the Fleshy Monstrosity, then finish the fight as usual.

bosses.name: Chimaerus, the Undreamt God
bosses.setup: 2 tanks · 4 healers · 14 DPS, split into two groups
bosses.summary: The raid splits into two groups that take turns in the Rift. Manifestations killed there leave puddles; any that escape walk to the boss and empower him. At 100 energy he flies, summons more, and eats anything still alive.
cliff: [D] NO ADD REACHES THE BOSS. Every one makes him hit harder and heals him.
[D] Everything dead before Ravenous Dive, or he eats it.
[THD] Your group soaks Alndust Upheaval, then goes to the Rift.
[HD] Miasma? Stand in an Alndust puddle, THEN get dispelled.
[T] Boss on one side of the room, never the middle.

items: Split into two even groups, each with 1 tank, half the healers and half the DPS.
Alndust Upheaval: a 10-yard soak circle on the tank. The group whose turn it is soaks it and drops into the Rift (spirit realm).
In the Rift, kill the Manifestations. Once they lose their shroud they come into reality and walk slowly to the boss.
Where they die, Alndust Essence zones form and keep expanding.
Swarming Shades: small adds, cleave them down.
Chimaerus takes off with Corrupted Devastation and summons Manifestations below.
Kill the Manifestations and keep clearing puddles with the Miasma dispels.
HC: Ravenous Dive: anything still alive gets eaten. Each one hits the raid, heals him for 500% of its remaining health and gives him +50% damage, stacking. On Heroic it no longer clears the pools.
Then back to Phase 1.

tank: Tank the boss on one side of the room, not the middle.
You get targeted by Alndust Upheaval: stand where your group can soak it with you.
When adds come out of the Rift, swap so the right tank picks them up.
healer: HC: Consuming Miasma: a curse on several players, damage every second for 12 seconds. Players step into Alndust Essence first, then you dispel: that removes the puddle too. On Heroic it's the only way to clear pools.
Insatiable and Cannibalized Essence hit the whole raid: a cooldown if an add gets through or gets eaten.
Each group has half the healers: stay with your group.
raid: Burn Manifestations in the Rift and on the way to the boss. Slows and stuns help.
Keep puddles at the edges so the floor stays usable.
Everything dead before Ravenous Dive.
wipes: Manifestations reach the boss and stack his damage.
Adds alive at Ravenous Dive.
Floor covered in Alndust Essence.
Boss tanked in the middle.

normal: No Consuming Miasma.
Ravenous Dive clears the pools for you.
heroic: Consuming Miasma: dispel players inside puddles to clear them.
Ravenous Dive no longer clears pools: Miasma is the only way.
mythic: Dissonance: you can't stand near players on the other floor.
Rift Madness: two players downstairs are feared and die unless soaked.
Teams split the room; Fearsome Cry must always be interrupted.

ach.name: Falling Between The Quacks
ach.req: Defeat Chimaerus after plucking all Corrupted Feathers from Sergeant Quackers and rescuing him from the Aln.
how: At the first Alndust Upheaval on the tank, Quackers goes downstairs and stays until every player has plucked a feather.
He comes back and attacks the boss; finish normally.
ach.note: After a wipe, collect him from the first platform again.
pre: Find Sergeant Quackers on the left side of the first platform and talk to him so he joins the fight.
Put a raid marker on him: he runs around.

pace.t: Go easy on the boss after the first Alndust Upheaval until every player has plucked a feather from Quackers. Once he's back attacking the boss, burn normally.

map.n: Each group has 1 tank, half the healers and half the DPS. The group on turn soaks Alndust Upheaval and drops into the Rift.
Manifestations walk from the Rift to the boss and leave growing Alndust Essence where they die: kill them near the edges.

bosses.name: Belo'ren, Child of Al'ar
bosses.summary: Every player and both tanks carry a Light or a Void feather. Each mechanic must be handled by the matching colour. Taking the boss to 0% in Phoenix form sends him into an egg for 30 seconds: burn it, then Phoenix form repeats with harder Embers each cycle.
bosses.hero: Pop Hero in an egg phase (around 30%), not in Phoenix form
bosses.style: Light vs Void colours · egg burns
cliff: [THD] MATCH YOUR COLOUR. Wrong colour on anything = big damage.
[T] Tanks: get hit by YOUR colour's Guardian's Edict cone. A miss gives him +30%.
[D] Kill the Ember, then swap to the egg before it Rebirths.
[THD] Interrupt Light / Void Eruption with the matching colour.
[THD] Death Drop: away from the middle, gateway out after the crash.

items: Open with a Light Dive or Void Dive: drop the puddle on the right marker; players of that colour soak it.
Kill the Ember, then hard swap to the egg and burn it before it can Rebirth. Later cycles spawn two Embers.
HC: Infused Quills: a beam aims at random players; a player of the matching colour stands in between to intercept it.
Radiant Echoes: orbs popped by the matching colour; the wrong colour takes heavy damage for 20 seconds.
Save Hero and big cooldowns for the egg.
At 0% he casts Death Drop: stand near the last puddle, away from the middle (damage and knock-up drop with distance). A Warlock Gateway right after the crash skips the knock-up.
Stand in your colour's cones, pop Radiant Echoes to make gaps, and use DPS cooldowns.
After 30 seconds he's back in Phoenix form and Phase 1 repeats.

tank: Light damage is Holy, Void is Shadow; Death Drop is Physical.
The two tanks always have opposite feathers.
Guardian's Edict: the tank of the matching colour must take the matching cone. A missed cone gives the boss +30% damage for 30 seconds, stacking.
Save big cooldowns for the egg phase.
healer: Burning Heart hits the raid every 3 seconds and ramps during each egg phase: the egg is the hardest healing.
Eternal Burns puts a big absorb on everyone and keeps doing damage until it's healed through.
Ashen Benediction: every Rebirth adds a permanent, stacking 10% healing reduction.
raid: Only soak Light / Void Dive if your colour matches. Puddles on the markers so you don't run out of room.
Light Eruption and Void Eruption hit the raid unless interrupted, and only the matching colour can interrupt them. Light Blast and Void Blast can be interrupted too.
Kill Embers fast and never let them Rebirth.
wipes: Hit by the wrong colour (Quills, Eruptions, Echoes).
Missed Guardian's Edict cones stacking his damage.
An Ember or egg Rebirths.
Healing falls behind as Ashen Benediction stacks.

normal: No Infused Quills.
heroic: Infused Quills: the matching colour must intercept the beam.
mythic: Our sources haven't listed the Mythic changes yet: see the full guides.

ach.name: Eggsistential Crisis
ach.req: Defeat Belo'ren after infusing the Sunwell Egg with Light and Void magic.
how: Each tank charges it fully with their colour before handing it over: dropping it early resets progress.
Not done in Phase 1? Tanks can hold it through the egg phases to finish.
ach.note: Reported to be buggy at times.
pre: Pick up the Sunwell Egg on the terrace to the left of the arena, up the stairs. A tank carries it into the pull.

pace.t: Play the fight normally while the tanks fully charge the egg with their colour. If it isn't done by the end of Phase 1, keep going through the egg phases: no need to hold damage.

bosses.name: Midnight Falls
bosses.summary: L'ura, the Season 1 finale, fought around The Darkwell: stepping into it (or being pulled in) kills you. Phase 1 is about rune order, crystals and matrices; an intermission pull; Phase 2 is Void Cores inside a trap circle; Phase 3 runs on Dawn Crystals until the boss dies or they run out.
bosses.hero: Pop Hero on pull: the early fight is on a set timer
cliff: [THD] NOBODY TOUCHES THE DARKWELL. Fight every pull.
[THD] Dark Runes: hit by the laser in the order the symbols appeared.
[D] Midnight Crystals grouped and dead before Cosmic Fracture; heal Dusk Crystals to full.
[THD] No Void Core left alive at Dark Meltdown.
[THD] P3: stay in the light, soak both Light Siphons, crystal up for every Dark Archangel.

items: Death's Dirge: five Dark Rune players must be hit by the rotating laser in the order their symbols appeared. Right order = Resonance (small raid damage); wrong order = Dissonance (usually a wipe).
Dodge Heaven's Glaives (bouncing glaives, the most common random death) and the Dark Quasar laser from The Darkwell.
Safeguard Prism: the boss takes 33% less damage. Interrupt or dispel the Safeguard Matrices until they're destroyed.
Midnight Crystals: group them and kill them before Cosmic Fracture. Dusk Crystals: heal them to full, or they also cast it. Healed ones become Dawn Crystals: assigned players pick them up.
Dawn Crystal holders take little damage. Never leave a crystal on the ground for more than 3 seconds.
HC: A Cosmic hit on a crystal holder triggers Tears of L'ura: two pools that must be soaked, or they become Naaru's Lament.
The phase ends when the boss reaches 0 energy.
Total Eclipse pulls everyone toward The Darkwell and stacks an absorb: fight the pull the whole time.
Dodge the rapid Dark Quasars.
Starsplinter: aim the spikes away from people. Crystal holders drop the crystal, sidestep, and pick it straight back up.
Iris of Oblivion traps the raid in a circle: leaving the outer edge kills you. Abyssal Pool deals constant raid damage.
HC: Split into four marker groups. Galvanize beams from four players hit the rotating Void Cores; extra players soak beams to reduce Overkill Current damage.
Hit cores from opposite sides so the Cosmic Fission pulls cancel out.
Core Harvest: avoid the marked lines.
At 100 energy, Dark Meltdown knocks everyone into Phase 3: stack in front of the boss first, with no Void Cores still active.
Thunderous Well: raid damage every 2 seconds for the whole phase.
Torchbearer: stay inside the 12-yard light around crystal holders.
The Dark Archangel wipes the raid without a Dawnlight Barrier: one Dawn Crystal per cast.
Black Tide: a frontal that leaves a puddle. Move or take a gate.
Dark Constellation: dodge the stars and the beams between them.
Light Siphon: fully soak both zones within 22 seconds, or Stellar Implosion wipes the raid.
Kill her before the crystals run out or Black Tide covers the room.

tank: Heaven's Lance stacks on each hit; at 5 stacks you get Impaled (50% more Heaven's Lance damage for 25 seconds). Swap after each cycle.
healer: Shattered Sky lasts 25 seconds and overlaps other mechanics: a big cooldown.
Abyssal Pool (Phase 2) and Thunderous Well (Phase 3) are constant raid damage.
Heal Dusk Crystals to full in Phase 1.
Dissonance and Naaru's Lament are huge spikes. Dispel the Safeguard Matrices.
raid: Grip and kill Midnight Crystals fast.
Soak Tears of L'ura when a crystal holder takes a Cosmic hit.
Interrupt or dispel Safeguard Matrices.
Hit Void Cores from opposite sides and soak Galvanize beams.
Dodge Glaives, Dark Quasar, Starsplinter, Dark Constellation and Black Tide; stay inside Torchbearer light.
wipes: Wrong Death's Dirge order (Dissonance).
A Void Core still active at Dark Meltdown.
Light Siphon not fully soaked (Stellar Implosion).
Dark Archangel without a Dawnlight Barrier.
Someone walks or gets pulled into The Darkwell, or leaves Iris of Oblivion.
Running out of crystals, or Black Tide covers the room.

normal: Galvanize isn't a group soak.
Cosmic hits on crystal holders don't make soak pools.
heroic: Galvanize becomes a group soak: four groups in Phase 2.
A Cosmic hit on a crystal holder makes two pools to soak (Tears of L'ura).
mythic: Our sources haven't listed the Mythic changes yet: see the full guides.

ach.name: All The Things She Said
ach.req: Defeat Midnight Falls after returning 12 Memories of Alleria to L'ura.
how: In Phase 3, find the 12 Memories around the room, interact with each and push them into L'ura before they despawn.
Move fast enough to beat the enrage.
pre: Light the Void Torch in the alcove to the right of the boss room.

pace.l: Burn early, race at the end
pace.t: Push Phases 1 and 2 hard to bank time: Phase 3 becomes a race between collecting all 12 Memories and the enrage. Assign who grabs which Memory.

bosses.name: Rotmire
bosses.summary: One phase on a loop: Rotmire builds to 100 energy and casts Fungal Bloom. Everything between Blooms is getting ready for the next one: every fungal add dead, corpses near the boss, vines out of the middle.
cliff: [D] EVERY ADD DEAD BEFORE FUNGAL BLOOM.
[D] Interrupt every Poison Burst.
[D] After Bloom: kill Bursting Shrooms one at a time.
[THD] Festering Vines? Step out to the side, never in the middle.
[T] Swap on every Putrid Fist.

items: Pull him where he stands and keep the raid grouped for interrupts and add swaps.
Awaken Fungi spawns Shroomlings that fixate random players. Stay away from the spawn spots: they explode and knock back.
HC: A stationary Sporecap spawns too. Interrupt its Poison Burst every time, kill it, and cleave Shroomlings on top of it. Heroic doesn't punish where corpses land.
At 100 energy, Fungal Bloom: heavy raid hit, 16-second DoT and knockback. Any fungal add still alive heals to full and gets Fungal Frenzy (+25% damage and speed, immune to CC and interrupts).
After Bloom, dead add corpses become Bursting Shrooms: swap and kill them; one explosion is fine, several are not. Kill adds near the boss so these spawn together.
Festering Vines: step to the side; when it expires it snaps into Writhing Vines. Keep those out of the middle.

tank: Putrid Fist: heavy Physical hit with a knock-up and 75% more Physical damage taken for 14 seconds. Swap every cast.
healer: Fungal Bloom: the big cooldown each cycle.
Poison Burst (if missed): raid damage plus a stacking DoT.
Bursting Pustules add Rotting Pustules stacks, a raid DoT that ramps all fight.
raid: Order: interrupt Poison Burst, kill the Sporecap, clean up Shroomlings on top of it.
Kill adds close to the boss.
wipes: Adds alive at Fungal Bloom (Fungal Frenzy).
Several Bursting Shrooms at once.
Missed Poison Burst interrupts.
Vines in the middle.
Holding Putrid Fist stacks.
Healing falling behind Rotting Pustules.

normal: No Sporecaps or Poison Burst: just Shroomlings.
heroic: Sporecaps spawn and cast Poison Burst: interrupt it every time.
mythic: Funglings join the adds.
Cross Fertilization: where adds die matters; a corpse placement check.

map.n: Kill Shroomlings and the Sporecap close to the boss so the Bursting Shrooms spawn together after Fungal Bloom.
Festering Vines: step out to the side. When it snaps into Writhing Vines it must be outside the middle.

bosses.name: Nek'zali the Soulcoiler

ach.name: Well, Well, Little Sky
ach.req: Defeat Nek'zali after returning Kupamanduka to the Soulcoil Well.
how: Get the frog Kupamanduka into the well in the middle of the room.
Keep mobs out of the well for the rest of the fight.
ach.note: Where Kupamanduka is wasn't confirmed when our source was written.
pre: Find Kupamanduka the frog (location not confirmed yet).

pace.t: Once the frog is in the well it's a normal kill: add control is what matters, since nothing may reach the well for the rest of the fight.

bosses.setup: 2 tanks · 4 healers · 14 DPS (magic dispels, strong AoE)
bosses.hero: Pop Hero in Phase 2 (after the intermission): it is a race against her energy
bosses.summary: Add control first: every add that reaches the Soulcoil Well gives Nek'zali 5 energy, and at 100 she enrages. At 50% she retreats to the well for an intermission, then Phase 2 is a damage race with constant raid damage.
cliff: [D] NOTHING REACHES THE WELL. Strip Amani shields with magic, then kill.
[T] Tank 30+ yards out, nobody in the Possession Barrage line.
[H] Dispel Essence Rend at the SIDE: the puddles come back in Phase 2.
[THD] Zero Ritual Burn stacks going into Soulcoil Ignition. Healer cooldowns.
[D] Intermission: melee soak Hungering Pyre, burn corpses, kill both Echoes.

items: Pull her to the entrance and face her away from the raid.
Possession Barrage on the current tank: four spirits hit the raid, less damage with distance. The tank stands 30+ yards away and nobody stands in the line.

Essence Rend: targets are pulled, knocked back and get a 15-second dispellable DoT. When it ends or is dispelled, a Latent Cultist puddle spawns under them. Put those somewhere harmless: they come back in Phase 2.
Restless Amani march from the sides toward the well. Their Gravebound Advance shield only absorbs magic damage: casters strip it, then everyone kills them before they arrive.
HC: Each Soulcoil Rite applies Ritual Burn: 15% more damage taken from later Rites for 60 seconds, stacking.
Soulcoil Ignition: four Soulcoil Rites in a row plus Anguished Echoes circles. The main healing check of Phase 1: go in with zero Ritual Burn stacks.
HC: Dead Amani leave corpses (Vessel of Awakening) that come back as empowered Amani in the intermission.
At 50% she goes back to the well and the intermission starts.
Soul Transfer: a 15-second channel that spawns an Echo of Jawae. Don't stand in the beam when it finishes.
Hungering Pyre: a group soak within 10 yards, split between everyone inside. Melee soak it. It also burns away corpses it sits on.
Slithering Flame chases non-soakers and sets them on fire; walk it over corpses to burn them away.
HC: Cremation: an expiring Slithering Flame explodes and burns corpses and Amani within 4 yards.
Kill both Echoes of Jawae to end it.
Uncoiling: Shadow damage to the raid every second for the rest of the fight. It's a race.
Invoke: the Phase 1 Latent Cultist puddles start moving around the well. Dodge them; fewer puddles from Phase 1 makes this easy.
Phase 1 abilities continue. Hero, potions and cooldowns: kill her before 100 energy.

tank: Hollowing Strikes: each stack is 5% less healing and absorbs on you. Swap at about 30–40%.
Stay 30+ yards out for Possession Barrage, with the line to you clear of players.
healer: Soulcoil Ignition is the big Phase 1 cooldown moment; each Soulcoil Rite is a raid Shadow hit with a stacking DoT.
Corpse Blight: dead Amani explode for raid Plague damage plus a stacking DoT.
Uncoiling is constant raid damage in Phase 2.
Dispel Essence Rend (magic) away from the raid: dispelling in the middle drops puddles where people need to walk.
raid: Break Restless Amani shields with magic damage, then kill them before the well.
Melee soak Hungering Pyre; everyone else kites Slithering Flame over corpses.
Kill both Echoes of Jawae to end the intermission.
Keep the Possession Barrage line clear, stay out of Soul Transfer, dodge Anguished Echoes and the moving puddles.
wipes: Several Amani reach the well.
Going into Soulcoil Ignition with Ritual Burn stacks.
Standing in the Possession Barrage line, or the tank too close.
Weak AoE in the intermission so corpses pile up.
Puddles left in walking paths for Phase 2.
Too slow: she reaches 100 energy.

normal: Soulcoil Rites don't stack Ritual Burn.
No corpses to clean up and no Cremation.
heroic: Ritual Burn: each Rite makes the next ones hit 15% harder, stacking.
Dead Amani leave corpses that come back in the intermission.
Cremation: expiring Slithering Flames burn nearby corpses and Amani.
mythic: Our sources haven't listed the Mythic changes yet: see the full guides.

map.n: Boss at the entrance facing away. Tank 30+ yards out for Possession Barrage, with nobody in that line. Amani march from the sides to the well.
Dispel at the side of the room: each one leaves a Latent Cultist puddle that comes back to life in Phase 2.
Melee soak Hungering Pyre. Others kite Slithering Flame over the Amani corpses to burn them. Kill both Echoes.

bosses.name: Entombed Sentinels

ach.name: Is Venom Stasis A Joke To You?
ach.req: Defeat the Entombed Sentinels after each one uses Vitriolic Stasis to restore more than half its total health.
how: Bring one Sentinel low before its Stasis and let the Stasis play out.
Do the same with the other.
Once both have healed up, finish the fight.

pace.t: Before each Vitriolic Stasis, bring one Sentinel low while the other stays high, so Stasis heals the low one for over half its health. Do that for both Sentinels, two separate intermissions, then kill them evenly. Expect a long pull.

bosses.summary: Two golems that buff each other when they're within 40 yards. Each team kills one on opposite sides of the room. At 100 energy they meet in the middle for Vitriolic Stasis, where the weaker one heals up to match the stronger, and everyone pairs up to make exactly 4 orbs.
cliff: [T] GOLEMS 40+ YARDS APART. Together they take 99% less damage.
[D] Keep their health even: Stasis refunds the difference.
[THD] Stasis pairs: your orbs + partner's orbs = exactly 4.
[THD] Red side: soak Unstable Miasma together, then spread.
[H] Dispel Blood Venom at the edge, NOT on cooldown.

items: Split into two teams, one per golem, tanked 40+ yards apart on opposite sides. Ula'tek's Dominance gives both 99% damage reduction if they get within 40 yards of each other.
Keep their health close: in each intermission the weaker one heals up to the stronger.
Teams swap sides at every intermission.
Green (Breath of Ula'tek): pop Toxic Droplets by stepping on them, one or two per player. Kill Venom Coagulation's slime first: its Contaminate hits the raid every 3 seconds until it dies.
HC: Living Venom: destroyed Toxic Droplets send venom back to the golem after 4 seconds, hitting anyone in the line.
Red (Blood of Ula'tek): Unstable Miasma is a mandatory group soak within 8 yards. Everyone hit gets Clinging Murk, so spread afterwards.
HC: Blood Venom: Clinging Murk and undispelled Blighted Blood leave pools when they expire. Start in a corner and line pools along the wall.
Both golems meet in the middle for 30 seconds with 99% damage reduction; the weaker heals to match.
Everyone gets Helical Toxins: pair with exactly one other player so your green orbs add up to 4. Wrong pairs cause Cultivated Burst.
HC: Going over 4 when you collide kills both players instead of knocking you apart.

tank: Green golem: Empowering Slam adds 15% Physical damage per slam on the same target and only resets on a new target: swap hard.
Red golem: Bloodvenom Injection is a Physical hit plus a stacking 40-second Shadow DoT. Swap before the stacks get scary.
The red tank drops a big puddle when Bloodvenom Injection expires: walk somewhere safe first.
Trade golems at every intermission.
healer: Contaminate (from Venom Coagulation) hits the raid every 3 seconds until the slime dies.
Noxious Blast from ignored Toxic Droplets and Cultivated Burst from bad pairs are huge.
Blighted Blood is a dispellable Shadow DoT. HC: it leaves a growing pool, so don't dispel on cooldown: dispel players at the edge.
raid: Spread the Toxic Droplets out: one or two each.
Kill the Venom Coagulation slime first on the green side.
HC: Stay out of the Living Venom return line.
Soak Unstable Miasma together, then spread.
wipes: Golems within 40 yards.
Uneven health that Stasis refunds.
Wrong Stasis pairs.
Late or missed Unstable Miasma soaks.
Venom Coagulation left alive.
Blood Venom pools in the playable space.

normal: No Living Venom return line.
No Blood Venom pools.
A bad Stasis pair knocks you apart instead of killing you.
heroic: Living Venom returns to the golem through anyone in the way.
Blood Venom pools from Clinging Murk and Blighted Blood.
Going over 4 in Stasis kills both players.
mythic: Shifting Protovenom: affected players touch each other to cancel it.
Protovenom Eruption: touching an unaffected player knocks back everyone nearby.

map.n: Each team takes one golem. Keep them 40+ yards apart or both take 99% less damage. Keep their health even.
Everyone soaks Unstable Miasma together (8 yards), then spreads for Clinging Murk. HC: pools go along the wall.
Golems meet in the middle. Pair up: your orbs + your partner's orbs = exactly 4. Then swap sides.

bosses.name: The Lost Explorers

ach.name: Accidental Inclusion
ach.req: Defeat The Lost Explorers, including Hoji.
how: Feed Hoji a Disgusting Fish so he becomes one of Mor'zahi's possession targets.
Then play the fight normally while handling his mechanics.
pre: Get a Disgusting Fish to feed to Hoji (where it comes from isn't confirmed yet).

pace.t: Feed Hoji first, then it's the normal fight with his mechanics on top. Treat the fish timer as tighter than usual and push damage.

bosses.summary: Three turtles (Nama, Iku, Gebbo) and Mor'zahi. Mor'zahi's energy builds to Final Ascension; feeding a Disgusting Fish to a turtle resets it and empowers that turtle's ultimate. You get three fish: the fourth time he reaches 100 energy is the enrage, so all three turtles must be dead by then.
cliff: [THD] THREE FISH, THEN IT'S OVER. All turtles dead before the 4th 100 energy.
[T] Never all three turtles within 30 yards: United Defense makes them immune.
[D] Box crew pops every crate inside 25 seconds.
[THD] Fire/frost debuff? Clear it in the OTHER element's patch.
[THD] Bomb wave: jump a mushroom, blink, or leap.

items: Mor'zahi's energy builds to Final Ascension. Feed a Disgusting Fish to a turtle to reset it; that turtle then does its big ultimate.
Keep explorer health balanced: early deaths set off Smashing Shovel, Cataclysmic Invocation and Relentless Escalation, which snowball.
Each fish breaks Mor'zahi and causes Fishy Feedback (raid damage plus a 12-second DoT): don't line it up with other big hits.
Crates: a permanent cleanup crew breaks every crate before the 25-second Relic Rupture timer.
Nama, Mighty Thud: three marked players, each needs bodies within 6 yards. An empty mark hits the whole raid. Avoid the Aftershock craters after.
Iku, Frostfire Volley: fire and frost missiles leave patches. Clear your debuff by standing in the OTHER element's patch before the next set. Frost targets melee, fire targets ranged.
Gebbo, Explosive Surprise: a bomb at the edge sends out a Blast Wave. Jump a Bouncy Mushroom, or blink, teleport or leap over it.

tank: Iku tank: Shredding Shards stacks 50% more damage taken for 80 seconds: swap on it.
Nama tank: Steady Strikes stacks 4% Physical damage per hit: swap on it.
Two turtles together for cleave, the third 30+ yards away (United Defense).
Don't stand in front of Nama: Shell Spin stuns for 4 seconds.
healer: Big hits: Relic Rupture, Cataclysmic Invocation, Blast Wave, Fishy Feedback.
Malevolent Presence: raid Shadow damage every 2 seconds.
Dispel: Splinters bleeds from crates, Icebound Flames DoTs, and Burning Flames / Piercing Frost if not cleared in time (or Elemental Explosion).
raid: Interrupt Icebound Flames.
Spread 30 yards for Blink Nova; stay 6+ yards from Mighty Thud landings.
Avoid Evil Eyes puddles.
If you must stagger kills: Gebbo, then Nama, then Iku.
wipes: Out of fish: Final Ascension.
Fire or frost debuff not cleared (Elemental Explosion).
A crate left 25 seconds (Relic Rupture).
Turtle deaths out of sync.
Empty Mighty Thud marks.
Touching the Blast Wave.

normal: Same mechanics as Heroic: our sources cover them together.
heroic: Same fight as Normal with more damage and health.
mythic: Breaking a crate gives the whole raid Splinters.
An unbroken crate does extra raid damage at 25 seconds.

map.n: Two turtles together for cleave, the third 30+ yards away (United Defense). Don't stand in front of Nama (Shell Spin).
Fire debuff: clear it in a FROST patch. Frost debuff: clear it in a FIRE patch.
A Blast Wave runs out from the bomb at the edge: jump a Bouncy Mushroom or blink/leap over it.

bosses.name: Vashnik the Malignant

ach.name: Kept You Waiting Huh?
ach.req: Defeat Vashnik after killing the Solidified Snake Venom.
how: Hold Vashnik at the venom fountain until the venoms he spawns merge into one giant Solidified Snake Venom.
Kill it, then finish Vashnik.

pace.t: Hold Vashnik at the fountain and let the venom adds merge instead of killing them, until the Solidified Snake Venom forms. Kill it, then burn Vashnik. Expect heavy raid damage: healer cooldowns.

bosses.summary: At 100 energy Vashnik Imbibes from the two nearest fountains, which spawns their venom adds and adds a permanent stack of Toxic Vapor. The default fountain order is Blood + Shadow, Shadow + Fire, Fire + Blood. Simplest plan: tank him between the Shadow and Fire fountains.
cliff: [D] KILL EVERY ADD BEFORE IT REACHES THE CENTER.
[D] Burning Venom: CC one, kill the other, never both at once.
[T] Swap on EVERY Dripping Fangs.
[H] Exploding Infection blows up when dispelled: one at a time, never at low health.
[THD] Catalytic Bile: someone within 6 yards of every impact.

items: Each Imbibe at 100 energy drains the two nearest fountains, spawns their adds, and adds a stack of Toxic Vapor (permanent, growing raid Nature damage).
Tanks walk him to the right fountains before each Imbibe.
Blood (Clotting Venom): can't be crowd controlled. Burn down every split.
Shadow (Shrouded Venom): can be CC'd. Lock extras and kill them where the Umbral Ejection circles are safe.
Fire (Burning Venom): CC one, kill the other, never let both die together. Death Knight grips pull them away from the middle; ranged keep them CC'd if there aren't enough grips.
HC: A Burning Venom explosion leaves a stacking DoT on the raid.
After 60 seconds, Hardened Venom makes surviving adds immune to CC and 50% faster.

tank: Dripping Fangs: big Physical hit plus a Nature DoT and +100% Physical damage taken for 32 seconds. Swap on every cast; never take it twice.
healer: Imbibe at 100 energy: healer cooldowns and defensives.
Malignant Burst (an add reached the center) and Malignant Catalyst (a bile not covered).
Caustic Surge / Explosion from Burning Venom deaths and dispelled Exploding Infection.
Siphoning (Blood) and Stygian (Shadow) Infections soak up healing and cut healing received to zero while active.
Exploding Infection (Fire) explodes on the raid when removed: stagger dispels and hold them when the raid is low.
raid: Kill adds on spawn: top priority.
Catalytic Bile: at least one player within 6 yards of each impact, without stacking.
Plague Froth: affected players spread and move away; everyone dodges the plus-shaped Plague Wave lines.
Stygian Infection: spread (6-yard bursts). Siphoning Infection: stand in the siphon circle.
wipes: Adds reaching the center (stacking Malignant Bursts).
Fight dragging on with too many Toxic Vapor stacks.
Fountain order drifting.
Uncovered Catalytic Bile.
Exploding Infection dispelled at low health, or several at once.
Burning Venoms dying together.
Missed Dripping Fangs swaps.

normal: Burning Venom explosions don't leave a DoT.
heroic: Burning Venom explosions leave a stacking raid DoT.
mythic: Our sources haven't listed the Mythic changes yet: see the full guides.

map.n: Imbibe drains the two fountains nearest him. Simplest plan: tank him between Shadow and Fire. Default order: Blood + Shadow, Shadow + Fire, Fire + Blood.
Kill every venom add before it gets to the middle. Burning Venoms: CC one, kill the other, never both at once.

bosses.name: Sszorak

ach.name: Jumping Through Hoops
ach.req: Defeat Sszorak while jumping through each ring that appears.
how: Use the wind knockbacks to fly through the rings.
ach.note: Personal achievement: people can get it on different weeks.

pace.t: A normal kill: each player flies through the rings during Crosswinds knockbacks. It's personal, so whoever misses can get it another week.

bosses.setup: 2 tanks · 4–5 healers · 13–14 DPS, two soak groups of 5+
bosses.hero: Pop Hero on pull (or in the intermission Dig In window if the raid moves well)
bosses.summary: A loop of Apex Predator, Venomous Surge, two Raging Crosswinds, then an intermission at 100 energy. Mark the possible wind tunnel spots around the room before the pull.
cliff: [THD] MUTILATE: 5 OR MORE, groups alternate. Never the same group twice.
[T] Swap between every Ravage.
[THD] Venomous Surge: run out, drop the cyst OPPOSITE the active tunnel.
[THD] Crosswinds: aim your arrow at another marked player.
[THD] Intermission: pixel stack in the middle and burn.

items: A 5-hit combo in random order: two Ravage, two Mutilate, one Tempest. All cones aim at the current tank; tanks taunt mid-combo.
Ravage (tank frontal): tanks alternate and take it at the platform edge.
HC: Mutilate (raid frontal): soak groups alternate. Soaking gives 500% more damage taken, so it needs two groups. Fewer than 5 soakers is lethal.
Tempest: roaming tornadoes; don't touch them.
Two players get a 10-second venom DoT that detonates on the raid with distance falloff: run away from the group first.
Each detonation leaves a Viscous Cyst. Place cysts at the markers opposite the active tunnels; the tunnel's orb count gives the wind order.
Four cysts for three winds: one spare.
HC: Caustic Claws during Surge leaves Caustic Residue pools (30% more damage taken): dodge them, and tanks move the boss to clean ground.
Marked players get arrow circles and are launched in that direction.
Point your arrow at another marked player and collide mid-air to land safely (touching circles counts). Miss and you drift toward the edge.
Knockback immunity can strand your partner.
Dig In: Sszorak takes 30% more damage for 25 seconds: the burn window.
Everyone pixel-stacks in the middle. Wind pushes you into the cyst opposite the tunnel, which knocks you back toward the boss and gives wind resistance.
Three winds; after the third, pop the spare cyst as a group.

tank: Ravage: massive Physical hit and 400% more damage taken for 25 seconds: swap between casts.
Corroding Venom: 3% more Physical damage taken per melee hit, stacking: swap on stacks.
healer: Ula'tek's Presence: raid Nature damage every 2 seconds all fight.
Venomous Surge detonations, Mutilate splits plus Mutilated Gash DoTs, and Ravage on the tank.
A fifth healer is optional.
raid: Two soak groups (for example melee and ranged).
Stay out of Ravage and Tempest.
Use the edge markers for cysts.
Stack tight in the intermission: one bad push starts a chain.
wipes: Mutilate soaked by fewer than 5, or the same group twice.
Missed Ravage or Corroding Venom swaps.
Two misplaced cysts (only one spare).
Intermission misstacks.
Touching Tempest, standing in Caustic Residue, or falling off in Crosswinds.

normal: Mutilate doesn't need two groups.
No Caustic Claws or Caustic Residue pools.
heroic: Mutilate soakers take 500% more damage: two alternating groups.
Caustic Claws leaves Caustic Residue (30% more damage taken).
mythic: Serpent's Fury builds rage toward Unbound Ferocity (a wipe).
To the Slaughter charge with Virulence spread beams.
Crosswinds come from four directions.

map.n: Soak groups of 5+ alternate on every Mutilate. Ravage goes to the tank at the platform edge.
Venomous Surge targets run out and drop the Viscous Cyst at the marker OPPOSITE the active wind tunnel.
Pixel-stack in the middle and burn (Dig In: +30% damage). The wind pushes you into the cyst, which knocks you back in.

bosses.name: The Twin Fangs

ach.name: Taking a Bite out of Slime
ach.req: Defeat the Twin Fangs after feeding Ithraz four slimes in order during Ravenous Feast: Crunchy Appetizer, Sumptuous Soup, Tasty Blob, Jiggly Dessert.
how: Slimekeepers don't soak Ravenous Feast until it's their turn to feed.
ach.note: Slimes reportedly follow their player through death for about an hour.
pre: Assign one player per slime: Crunchy Appetizer, Sumptuous Soup, Tasty Blob, Jiggly Dessert.
Each slimekeeper finds their slime before the pull.

pace.t: Normal pace, but you need four Ravenous Feasts with the slimekeepers feeding in order. Keepers skip Feast soaks until their turn, so the other teams cover more: watch Eternal Venom stacks. Don't kill them before the fourth feed.

bosses.summary: Vexhul and Ithraz don't share health and can't be moved: spread loosely and kill both at the same time. The loop runs twice per cycle, then they Submerge at 100 energy. The third Submerge is the hard enrage (Caustic Rain).
cliff: [THD] 10 ETERNAL VENOM = DEAD. Ravenous Feast is the only cleanse.
[THD] Three Feast groups. Nobody soaks twice.
[THD] One low-stack player per Caustic Globule.
[D] Both serpents die together.
[THD] Vile Flood: move against the rotation, cross early.

items: Caustic Deluge: Vexhul's tank channels; globules spawn around the room, one soaker each. An unsoaked globule gives the whole raid a stack.
Stone Breaker: Ithraz's tank soaks three swirls.
Venomous Emergence: a raid-wide Eternal Venom stack and three serpents in the middle.
Coiling Ichor: targets walk to the edge and drop slowing pools there.
Stir the Depths: raid damage and green waves to dodge.
Ravenous Feast: three explosions; each soaker loses one Eternal Venom stack.
HC: Soaking applies Feasted (800% more Feast damage for 8 seconds), so each player soaks only one hit: three teams.
HC: Eternal Venom kills you at 10 stacks.
Vile Flood: Vexhul's rotating laser. Move against its rotation and cross early.
Sanguine Storm: gore impacts and slowing pools; dodge while rotating.
HC: Congealed Gore pools slow you by 60%.
Noxious Slick puddles from Submerge raise damage taken: stay out.
The third Submerge casts Caustic Rain and ends the pull: both must die before it.

tank: Vexhul: Caustic Deluge stacks Envenomed for 90 seconds: swap as it builds.
Ithraz: Stone Breaker adds damage per soak for 90 seconds: tanks alternate swirl sets and run back in after the roar knockback.
Stay in range of your serpent or it spits at the raid (Concentrated Spittle / Clotted Bolt).
healer: Toxic Fumes: raid Nature damage every 2 seconds.
Spikes: Ravenous Feast, Venomous Emergence, Stir the Depths, and missed Stone Breaker slams (armor-ignoring raid damage plus knockback).
No dispels: Eternal Venom only comes off through Feast.
raid: Corrosive Spit targets: aim the line away from the raid.
Kill Spawns of Vexhul fast: they fixate players.
Coiling Ichor: let the pool expire away from the group.
wipes: Eternal Venom reaching 10.
Double-soaking Feast or not enough groups.
Uneven health: the survivor gets Uncoiled Wrath.
Missed Stone Breaker slams.
Caught in Vile Flood or Noxious Slick.
Too slow: third Submerge.

normal: Eternal Venom doesn't kill at 10.
No Feasted: players can soak more than one Feast hit.
Congealed Gore doesn't slow.
heroic: 10 Eternal Venom stacks kills you.
Feasted: three Feast soak teams.
Congealed Gore pools slow by 60%.
mythic: Dying with Eternal Venom spawns more globules.
Barbed Bulwark shields on globules must be interrupted.
Rouse the Brood adds to interrupt; Tainted Blood soaks after each Feast.

map.n: The serpents can't move. Tanks stay in range of their serpent or it spits at the raid. Kill both together.
Each soak removes one Eternal Venom stack. HC: nobody soaks twice (Feasted), so three teams take one each.
Vexhul's laser rotates: move against the rotation and cross it early.

bosses.name: The Coiled Altar

ach.name: Watch Out Behind You
ach.req: Defeat The Coiled Altar while all players are afflicted by Unnerving Fixation.
how: In the later phases, DPS off Dreadmarch so Manifestations of Dread spawn and fixate random players.
Keep it going until everyone has Unnerving Fixation, without getting possessed.

pace.l: Hold damage late in the fight
pace.t: Play the early phases normally. In the later phases, go easy on damage during Dreadmarch so ghosts keep spawning and fixate everyone, then burn once the whole raid has Unnerving Fixation.

bosses.setup: 2 tanks · 5 healers · 13 DPS (poison dispels, interrupts, raid cooldowns)
bosses.hero: Pop Hero in the intermission after Phase 2, on Zul'jan
bosses.summary: Zul'jan in Phase 1, Malacrass in Phase 2, an intermission where you burn Zul'jan, then both together in Phase 3. Stay stacked behind the boss all fight: you come back to that formation every phase.
cliff: [THD] STACK BEHIND THE BOSS. Every phase.
[THD] Guillotine: 5+ soak, groups alternate, gate out.
[THD] Gloombomb: detonate away, collect your Soul Fragments within 15 seconds.
[D] Kick Wail of Terror LATE; Spiritcackle dead before 100 energy.
[D] Phase 3: kill both bosses together.

items: Toxic Deluge loop: orb carriers pick up Coalesced Venom and pile it in the middle; the Sever tank clears the pile. Don't stack while carrying an orb: it pulses and drops after 5 seconds.
HC: Venom Rupture stacks as a DoT: don't pop too many orbs at once.
Dodge Axegrinder axes, dispel Venomfang (poison).
Guillotine: 5+ soakers. HC: Guillotined soakers take 500% more from the next one, so two groups alternate.
At 0% Zul'jan detonates the remaining orbs: raid cooldown.
Dreadmarch mind-controls players: free them with AoE and pull back anyone near the edge. Freed players spawn Manifestation of Dread ghosts. HC: a ghost that reaches its target reapplies Dreadmarch.
Fixated players kite ghosts to the middle and face them to freeze them; the tank clears them with Soul Sever.
Spiritcackle: bring the boss and raid to the add. Kick Wail of Terror late (each kick blinks it). Kill it before 100 energy or it fears the raid.
Gloombomb: three players spread, detonate away from the group, then collect Soul Fragments within 15 seconds. HC: anyone hit gets Gravebound.
Eternal Nightfall: break the Veil of Twilight shield to interrupt it. Its Suffocating Darkness absorbs can't be healed through.
Push after a Soul Sever and before the next Dreadmarch; stand toward the middle for the 0% knockback.
Malacrass is immune. Zul'jan takes 100% more damage and heals himself: Hero, everything on Zul'jan.
Block Fragments of Malacrass to stop his healing. Each block causes Spirit Erasure (raid hit, stacking damage taken), so spread the blocks out.
Keep the bosses together for cleave and kill them at the same time: Soulbound berserks the survivor.
Open like Phase 1 with orbs in the middle; after the first Defilement of the Coiled Altar, ignore orbs and kill both evenly.
Grim Guillotine, Gloombomb, Eternal Nightfall and Dreadmarch all layer together. Every cooldown for the final push.

tank: Phase 1: Sever, a Physical cone with 200% more damage taken for 45 seconds. Swap every cast; use it to clear orbs.
Phase 2: Soul Sever, a Shadow cone with stacking damage taken and a DoT; clears ghosts. Swap on stacks.
Phase 3: Blighted Sever clears orbs and ghosts; Corrupted Toxin stacks a Shadow DoT from Zul'jan's melee. Swap to shed stacks.
healer: Venom Rupture stacks and the Phase 1 push, Guillotine and Grim Guillotine, Eternal Nightfall, Defilement in Phase 3, Spirit Erasure stacks.
Dreadful Presence: raid Shadow damage all of Phase 2.
Poison-dispel Venomfang or it ticks for 14 seconds.
Suffocating Darkness, Grim Guillotine and Defiled Ground absorb healing.
raid: Guillotine: the target goes to the purple corner marker with their group; everyone gates out when it lands.
Soul Fragments within 15 seconds or you die; Gravebound fragments must be reclaimed too.
Burn Zul'jan in the intermission.
wipes: Failed Guillotine soak.
Missed Soul Fragments.
Spiritcackle reaching 100 energy.
Eternal Nightfall shield not broken.
One boss dies first in Phase 3.
Too many fragment blocks at once.

normal: Venom Rupture isn't a DoT.
One Guillotine group is enough.
No Gravebound from Gloombomb; ghosts don't reapply Dreadmarch.
heroic: Venom Rupture stacks as a DoT.
Guillotined: two alternating soak groups.
Gloombomb gives Gravebound; ghosts reaching their target reapply Dreadmarch.
Spiritcackle's Wail of Terror to interrupt.
mythic: Virulent Cyst and Virulent Mutation orbs.
Guillotined becomes permanent; axes don't despawn.
Ghosts only visible to their target; Spiteful Soulcoiler shield.

map.n: Every phase starts from the same spot: the raid stacked behind the boss, tank in front.
The target goes to the purple corner marker with their soak group (5+); everyone gates out when it lands. HC: groups alternate.
Three targets detonate away from the group, then collect their Soul Fragments within 15 seconds.

bosses.name: Ula'tek

ach.name: No Egg Scramble
ach.req: Defeat Ula'tek before the Greasy Hatchling breaks.
how: The raid picks up the Greasy Hatchling egg and passes it every 20 seconds (the debuff's length) until the boss dies.
ach.note: Method not confirmed yet. Also gives the Ula'took battle pet.
pre: Find the Greasy Hatchling egg (pickup spot not confirmed yet).

pace.l: Burn as fast as you can
pace.t: The egg has to be passed every 20 seconds for the whole fight, so every minute is three more passes to miss. Full damage and a tight pass order.

bosses.setup: 2 tanks · 5 healers · 13 DPS, two equal groups
bosses.hero: Pop Hero on the first Rage of the Shackled damage amp in Phase 1
bosses.summary: The Serpent Mother. Phase 1 loops coils, waves and eggs into a damage amp; Phase 2 splits the raid to clear the Doomscale corridors; an intermission shatters the platform; Phase 3 is spread across breaking platforms until the final burn.
cliff: [T] MELEE AND TAIL ALWAYS COVERED. Empty = Mother's Wrath / Rattler Slam.
[THD] Spectral Coils: your group's soak only.
[D] No uncontrolled egg hatches.
[H] Every Serpent's Bite fully soaked, then spread for Volatile Purge.
[THD] Off the platform before Circling Prey.

phases.t: Phase 1: Fury of the Serpent Mother
items: Grab the 3 starting eggs on pull (touching them pulls the boss).
Loop: Spectral Coils, then Caustic Waves (run opposite the wing she pulls back), a submerge at the bubble marks, then an egg wave.
HC: Soak Spectral Coils in two groups (Normal lets everyone soak each one). Soaking pops your eggs, which is intended.
The first damage amp follows: Hero and all cooldowns on the Venomous Heart while dodging Falling Debris.
Cross to your assigned side with grips and rescues; save the Warlock gate for the way back.
Kill the Doomscale Warden in the corridor and cleave the Blightscale Clutch eggs it spawns. Interrupt Malice.
Snap Grasping Fangs two at a time, letting the DoT fall off between pairs.
Feed eggs into the Doomscale Cauldron, small first, the big Doomscale Egg last.
Interrupt the Weakened Doomscale's Anguished Cry, then gate back and stack for the second damage amp.
Pick up all eggs. HC: Spectral Coils alternate: Group 1 takes casts 1, 3, 5; Group 2 takes 2, 4, 6.
The platform breaks into four: stand to the side, avoid the middle, and ride the knock-up into Phase 3.
Melee on the boss platform; ranged and healers counter-clockwise.
Serpent's Bite hits one melee, one healer and one ranged: three soak groups, fully soak, then spread for Volatile Purge.
Move off the platform before Circling Prey breaks it.
Each Call of the Serpent spawns a Blightscale Shrieker: taunt and kill fast, interrupt Vicious Echoes, never let Acidic Expulsion pass 2 stacks.
The second platform break is the hardest moment: every defensive.
Last platform: final Bite, dodge the last wave, spread for the Purge, then burn her before the final break.

tank: Keep the boss's melee AND the tail covered at all times: an empty melee triggers Mother's Wrath, an empty tail triggers Rattler Slam.
Swap during casts or waves, never on open GCDs. Swap on high Stone Venom stacks.
Cooldowns for both damage amps, and big personals for the second Phase 3 platform break.
healer: Necrotic Vapors: constant, growing raid Nature DoT.
Spikes: Spectral Coils, Mother's Wrath, Rattler Slam, Calcified Corpse, Putrid Membrane, Fury Unleashed.
Poison dispels needed. An untended Serpent's Bite becomes a Calcified Corpse that kills the raid.
raid: Interrupts: Malice (Warden), Anguished Cry (Weakened Doomscale), Vicious Echoes (Shrieker).
Run opposite the Caustic Waves wing; dodge Falling Debris and Virulent Spit.
Snap Grasping Fangs in pairs to avoid Blight Vein.
wipes: An untended Serpent's Bite (Calcified Corpse).
Uncontrolled egg hatches (Blightscale Vipers).
Empty tail or melee.
Not off the platform before Circling Prey.
Shrieker stacks over 2.
Reaching Fury Unleashed with the boss not nearly dead.

normal: The whole raid soaks each Spectral Coils together.
heroic: Spectral Coils split into two groups; in the intermission they alternate 1-3-5 / 2-4-6.
mythic: Our sources haven't listed the Mythic changes yet: see the full guides.

bosses.name: Nymrissa Wavecaller
bosses.summary: A repeating loop: a Shorerunner swarm runs at the Alluring Bubble, then Swirling Whirlpools head for it and Pop! the bubble, with Frost Orb soaks and Water Jet swaps throughout. Wavecaller's Might (3% more Frost damage per stack) is the soft enrage; Unending Tides is the hard enrage.
cliff: [D] SHORERUNNERS NEVER REACH THE BUBBLE. Berserkers die on sight.
[THD] Whirlpools: run to the gap and stack together.
[THD] Pop!: stand close to the bubble, not toward the water (sharks).
[THD] Soak Frost Orbs, don't dodge them. Leave Lingering Frost off the paths.
[T] Swap on Water Jet stacks.

items: Shorerunners run at the bubble: stop them first. Bring the boss to the spawn with the most adds; ranged take single spawns. Any CC works.
Berserkers: kill on sight. They pulse raid Frost damage every 3 seconds (Pulsing Tides).
Swirling Whirlpools head for the bubble: run to the single gap and stack.

Pop!: when a whirlpool reaches the bubble, raid Frost damage and a knockback. Stand close to the bubble so you're not knocked into the water, where sharks eat you. A Warlock Gateway cancels the knockback.
Abyssal Rain: a 4-second raid channel with a lingering DoT: a healing check.
HC: Frost Orbs must be soaked (an untouched orb Shatters for massive raid damage). Soaking leaves Lingering Frost that ticks and makes you slide: keep it off paths and away from the bubble.
Unending Tides is the hard enrage: kill her before it channels.

healer: Cooldowns for Pop! and Abyssal Rain, especially when they land with Berserker Pulsing Tides.
Orb soakers take heavy Frost damage, a stacking DoT and 20% more Frost damage for 16 seconds.
tank: Water Jet: Frost damage and a push; each hit adds 20% more Water Jet damage taken for 35 seconds. Swap on stacks.
Water Jet washes away Lingering Frost: aim pushes across icy floor.
Tanks are the best Frost Orb soakers.
raid: Kill order: Berserkers, then Shorerunners.
Soak orbs; never dodge them.
wipes: Pulsing Tides overlapping Abyssal Rain or Pop!.
Knocked into the water.
Untouched Frost Orbs (Shatter).
Water Jet stacks too high.
A slow kill into Unending Tides.

normal: Frost Orbs don't need to be soaked.
heroic: Frost Orbs must be soaked; soaking leaves Lingering Frost.
mythic: Bubblefin Frostscale's Waterfog Shield gives nearby murlocs 99% damage reduction: kill it first.
Frost Burst: every orb soak hits the raid, so stagger soaks.

map.n: Shorerunners run at the Alluring Bubble: stop them. Berserkers die on sight.
Run to the gap between whirlpools and stack. On Pop!, stand close to the bubble so the knockback doesn't throw you in the water.

bosses.name: Kith'ix
bosses.summary: Phase 1 is add control: Voidswarm sends Venomous Hulks, Voidweavers and Bomber Beetles. At 100 energy Lady Liadrin holds up the Refulgent Bulwark through an intermission. At 25% Phase 2 starts: Eightfold Eclipse counts to eight, and the eighth cast wipes.
bosses.setup: 2 tanks · 4 healers · 14 DPS (fear dispels, CC for beetles)
bosses.hero: Pop Hero when Phase 2 starts at 25%: about a minute before the enrage
cliff: [THD] ADDS 25+ YARDS FROM KITH'IX. Voidweavers first.
[THD] Grab a Light's Embrace orb before every Extinguish.
[H] Overwhelming Fear: stagger the dispels.
[D] All adds dead before the intermission, then stay inside the Bulwark.
[THD] Phase 2: Hero, gates by role, kill before the 8th Eclipse.

items: Keep adds 25+ yards from Kith'ix.
Venomous Hulk: the off-tank parks it on a Voidweaver for cleave.
Voidweavers: top priority; they can't be moved.
Bomber Beetles: CC them and set them off one at a time (Death Knight grips help; otherwise root them and have an assigned player run into each). Each detonation adds a stacking raid DoT.
HC: Voidweavers drop two Mind Stinger Eggs and the Hulk drops four: kill the eggs right after the adds die, before they hatch.
Extinguish: an 8-second raid cast. Everyone collects one Light's Embrace orb for damage reduction; missed it? Use a defensive.
Dodge Twisted Appendages slam circles.
Kill every add first or they enrage.
Stay inside the Refulgent Bulwark; the darkness outside kills.
HC: Soak Eclipse Fragments, including ones aimed at Liadrin, so the Bulwark holds. Soaking gives a stacking 6-second DoT to you and those nearby.
HC: Soak Voidscar orbs from the tank puddles.
Liadrin reaching 100 energy ends it. Each intermission adds an Exhausted stack that weakens the Bulwark.
Remaining adds are destroyed; Luminous Grace gives the raid 50% more damage.
Every Eightfold Eclipse hits the raid: the eighth wipes it.
Null Gates: one melee, one ranged and one healer get a gate. Drop them in assigned spots by role, dodge Nullshards and watch Nullify stacks (lethal at 5 on Heroic).

tank: Dark Devastation: Physical and Shadow hit that applies Devastated (more damage taken): cooldown for it and swap after each.
Venom Roar (Hulk): Physical and Nature cone knockback; Death's Advance or Charge negates it.
HC: Voidscar explosions leave a puddle that spawns an orb: drop them near the edge and soak in the intermission.
Phase 2 Negation: taunt swap immediately and run into a Null Gate within 8 seconds. Explosive Restabilization hits hard and destroys gates within 10 yards: defensive.
healer: Big hits: Extinguish, Eightfold Eclipse, and Nightfall stacks from Voidweavers.
Overwhelming Fear: stagger dispels; each one deals raid damage by distance.
Abyssal Grasp: heal the absorb off within 8 seconds or the player is pulled into the darkness and dies.
raid: Priority: Voidweavers, then the Hulk through cleave, then eggs.
Use a defensive when channeled by Voidweave with high Nightfall stacks.
Follow your role's Null Gate spot in Phase 2.
wipes: Adds alive at the intermission.
Missed Light's Embrace orbs before Extinguish.
Abyssal Grasp not removed in 8 seconds.
Fear dispels all at once.
Missed Null Gate on Negation, or too many Nullify stacks.
Eggs hatching.
The eighth Eightfold Eclipse.

normal: No Mind Stinger Eggs, Voidscar orbs or Eclipse Fragments.
Nullify kills at 6 stacks.
heroic: Mind Stinger Eggs from Voidweavers and the Hulk.
Voidscar orbs and Eclipse Fragments in the intermission.
Nullify kills at 5 stacks.
mythic: Bomber Beetles also drop eggs.
Nullify kills at 3 stacks.
More health and damage.

map.n: Keep every add 25+ yards from Kith'ix. Park the Hulk on a Voidweaver for cleave.
All adds dead first. Everyone inside Liadrin's Refulgent Bulwark: the darkness outside kills. HC: soak the Eclipse Fragments.
One melee, one ranged and one healer each get a gate: drop them in the assigned spots. Tanks run into a gate on Negation.

s1.name: Glory of the Midnight Raider
s1.note: Boss achievements from the Voidspire, the Dreamrift and March on Quel'Danas, Normal or higher.
